title: Inside of Busan Train Station | Korea Station | Rail Ninja Review
description:
Welcome to Busan Station – your gateway to the vibrant heart of South Korea's second-largest city! As a major hub for the KTX high-speed train, this bustling station is your starting point for seamless travel to Seoul, Daegu, and countless other incredible destinations.

In this video, we'll give you a complete tour of Busan Station. Beyond the train platforms, we'll explore the fascinating area right outside, including the  must-see tourist sights like Yongdusan Park with its iconic Busan Tower and the famous Jagalchi Fish Market and BIFF Square for an unforgettable street food experience.

Ready to explore South Korea by train? Explore the top routes at https://www.rail.ninja?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=busan_station_video, book your tickets and enjoy an unforgettable adventure on the rails!
